units.summary: Adds an idempotent setter that appends the from-selected-series hint and sorts Hints, the same way SetStaleSeries does. The hint is written into block meta.json.
units.headline: New setter adds from-selected-series compaction hint to block meta
units.reason: It writes a new hint value into the persisted meta.json format that other tools read.
focus: External consumers of meta.json hints (Thanos, Mimir) can tolerate the new 'from-selected-series' value

units.summary: Adds a predicate that checks Hints for the from-selected-series hint. Callers use it to exclude these blocks from in-order maxt and to carry the hint forward in Write.
units.headline: New predicate checks for the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Simple slices.Contains check; the risk sits in its callers, which are reviewed separately.

units.summary: New unit test covering the set/get round trip, idempotency, and coexistence with the stale-series hint. Test-only.
units.headline: Tests selected-series hint round trip and idempotency
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: Write now copies the FromSelectedSeries hint from the base meta to the new block, as it already does for the stale-series and OOO hints. This changes which hints end up in persisted blocks.
units.headline: Write carries the selected-series hint over from the base meta
units.reason: Changes the hints persisted on compacted blocks, which affects how blocks are classified later.
focus: Whether the multi-block Compact path should also keep or drop this hint when merging selected-series blocks with normal blocks

units.summary: Blocks tagged from-selected-series no longer count toward the in-order max time, matching the existing stale-series and OOO exclusions. This changes the watermark used for head/compaction decisions.
units.headline: In-order max time now ignores selected-series blocks
units.reason: Changes the watermark computation, which affects compaction and appendable-range decisions.
focus: Callers of inOrderBlocksMaxTime that behave correctly when only selected-series blocks exist (ok=false)
Selected-series blocks rolled up into higher-level blocks: the hint must still be present after the roll-up, or those blocks start driving the watermark

units.summary: New test checking that a series with OOO data is skipped and stays in the head, while the other series is compacted into a block carrying the hint. Test-only.
units.headline: Tests that CompactSelectedSeries skips series with OOO data
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: New test that rewrites a selected-series block through compactor.Write and checks the hint survives. Test-only.
units.headline: Tests that the selected-series hint survives compactor.Write
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: New test checking that inOrderBlocksMaxTime reports no in-order block when only a selected-series block exists. Test-only.
units.headline: Tests that in-order max time excludes selected-series blocks
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.
